description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {U/B}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.
